name: Browserbase
one_liner: Hosted, scalable headless-browser infrastructure for AI agents.
summary: Browserbase runs headless browsers as a service so that AI agents and scrapers don't have to manage Playwright fleets, proxies, captcha handling, or session persistence. Pairs naturally with Stagehand at the agent layer.

name: Stagehand
one_liner: Open-source AI browsing framework from Browserbase: act, extract, observe.
summary: Stagehand is an open-source TypeScript/Python framework that wraps Playwright with three primitives — `act`, `extract`, `observe` — so an LLM can drive a browser at the level of natural-language intents rather than CSS selectors. Designed to run on top of Browserbase or a local Playwright.

name: Exa
one_liner: Neural search API plus an excellent MCP server for live web/github/linkedin search.
summary: Exa is a search API designed for LLMs: semantic over the open web, plus specialised endpoints for GitHub, LinkedIn, academic search, and 'find similar pages.' Their MCP server is one of the strongest off-the-shelf research tools for agents.

name: Apify
one_liner: Marketplace of pre-built scraping 'actors' you can call as APIs or via MCP.
summary: Apify hosts thousands of pre-built scrapers ('actors') for everything from Show HN to TikTok comments. You call them as APIs (or via the Apify MCP server) and get structured JSON back. The 'website-content-crawler' and 'rag-web-browser' actors handle the long tail of JS-heavy product sites.

name: Firecrawl
one_liner: Crawl + scrape any website into clean markdown for LLMs.
summary: Firecrawl normalises web pages into LLM-ready markdown with structured metadata. Good when you want a single API to feed RAG pipelines without writing site-specific scrapers. Open-source self-host option exists.

name: Clay
one_liner: GTM data platform with a built-in agent ('Claygent') for arbitrary enrichment.
summary: Clay is the spreadsheet-like GTM data platform sales teams use to enrich leads, find waterfall data, and run Claygent — an agent that can scrape, search, and call APIs to fill any cell. Strong for B2B prospecting workflows.

name: LangGraph
one_liner: Stateful, graph-based agent orchestration from LangChain.
summary: LangGraph is the LangChain team's framework for explicitly modelling agent loops as graphs of nodes (tools, conditions, supervisors). More verbose than CrewAI but gives you structured retry, branching, and human-in-the-loop primitives.

name: CrewAI
one_liner: Multi-agent collaboration framework — give roles, get crews.
summary: CrewAI lets you compose specialised agents into a 'crew' with explicit roles, goals, and tasks. The abstraction is friendly for teams new to agent building; less control than LangGraph but faster time-to-prototype.

name: n8n
one_liner: Open-source workflow automation with an AI-friendly node ecosystem.
summary: n8n is the OSS Zapier — visual workflow builder with hundreds of integrations. Increasingly the default deliverable for 'automation as a service' shops; a community library of AI templates makes it easy to ship copy-paste agents.

name: Vercel AI SDK
one_liner: TypeScript SDK for streaming AI UIs and tool-using agents.
summary: Vercel AI SDK is the cleanest TS abstraction for building streaming chat UIs and tool-using agents on top of OpenAI / Anthropic / Google. Pairs naturally with Next.js + Vercel hosting; produces production-grade streaming UIs out of the box.

name: OpenAI Agents SDK
one_liner: Official OpenAI SDK for building autonomous tool-using agents.
summary: OpenAI's first-party Python (and TS) SDK for agent loops: tool registration, handoffs between agents, structured outputs, automatic retry. The official path if you're committed to OpenAI models.

name: Claude Agent SDK
one_liner: Anthropic SDK for building autonomous agents on Claude.
summary: Anthropic's SDK for autonomous agents — what powers Claude Code. Strong tool-use loop, native MCP server registration, file system + bash + web search out of the box. Best-in-class for code-heavy or long-running agents.

name: Mem0
one_liner: Long-term memory layer for AI agents — stores facts, retrieves on demand.
summary: Mem0 stores user-level facts and retrieves them at query time via a vector + graph index. Decides ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NONE per turn via an LLM judge prompt. Easy drop-in for chat apps that need 'remember my preferences' behaviour.

name: Supermemory.ai
one_liner: Hosted long-term memory API with personalisation primitives.
summary: Supermemory provides a hosted memory API with first-class concepts like 'spaces' (per-user contexts), graph-backed retrieval, and built-in deduplication. Less battle-tested than Mem0 but more product-shaped.

name: ElevenLabs
summary: ElevenLabs is the default voice-synthesis API for production AI voice apps in 2026 — best quality on most languages, fast streaming, voice cloning. Pairs with HeyGen for lipsync video.
